cohort: The study included Late-FGR (GA >= 32 weeks, n = 23), Non-FGR (GA >= 32 weeks, n = 39), and Early-FGR (GA 30+0-31+6 weeks) neonates.
finding: Late-FGR had limited impact on left ventricular cardiac output, SVC and DV blood flow in the early neonatal period, with most adaptive circulatory changes occurring early during transition, although Late-FGR neonates exhibited lower left ventricular stroke volume and higher heart rate on day three compared to Non-FGR.
birth_weight: Included FGR and Non-FGR neonates; birth weight was adjusted for in the analysis.
